question: Dr. Manmohan Singh was recently honored with a Lifetime Achievement Honour by which organization for his contributions to economic and political life?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India- Uk Achievers Honours**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Manmohan Singh was conferred a Lifetime Achievement Honour in 2023 by the India-UK Achievers Honours in London.
 
• This recognition was for his significant contributions to the economic and political life of India.
 
• Manmohan Singh, a renowned economist, served as the Prime Minister of India from 2004 to 2014.
 
• Under his leadership, India witnessed substantial economic growth and development.
 
• He played a pivotal role in the liberalization of the Indian economy in the early 1990s.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• UK's Department for International Trade (DIT)
 
 
• The Department for International Trade (DIT) is a UK government department responsible for promoting international trade and investment.
 
• Established in 2016, its primary goal is to ensure that the UK becomes a global leader in free trade and international commerce following its departure from the European Union.
 
 
 
• University of Oxford
 
 
• The University of Oxford, located in Oxford, England, is one of the oldest and most prestigious universities in the world, tracing its origins to 1096.
 
• Known for its rigorous academic standards and rich history, it has consistently ranked among the top universities globally.
 
 
 
• United Nations (UN)
 
 
• The United Nations (UN) is an intergovernmental organization established in 1945 in the aftermath of World War II.
 
• Its primary mission is to maintain international peace and security, develop friendly relations among nations, and foster cooperation on international issues.
